Funds for rice research
2491. SHRI GHULAM NABI AZAD:
DR.T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the press report which
appeared in The Hindu dated the 26th June,
2002 under the heading, "Funds crunch hits
rice research";
(b) if so, whether the tight squeeze on
funding by developed countries has severely
hit research programme of the Manila-based
International Rice Research Institute (IRRI)
in rainfed varieties of rice, that are resistant
to drought, floods and salinity;
(c) if so, the reasons for the same; and
(d) what steps Government propose to
take toprovide funds, so that it does not hit
rice research work in the Institution?
Production of vegetables
2492. SHRI HARENDRA SINGH
MALIK: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the estimated production of
vegetables per year in the country;
(b) whether a large quantity of vegetables
get perished every year;
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
prevent the same?
Import of improved variety seeds
†2493. PROF. R.B.S. VARMA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have to import
seeds of improved variety in order to meet
their shortage;
(b) if so, the total number of the varieties
of seeds imported during the last three years
and the amount spent year-wise on their
import, separately; and
(c) the details of distribution of those
seeds to various States/Union Territories?

Loss of wheat, paddy and millet
production
†2494. SHRI RAJIV RANJAN SINGH
'LALAN':
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that total annual
production of fruits and vegetables in the
country is estimated to be worth around
rupees one lakh crore;
(b) the estimated value of annual
production of wheat, paddy and millets in
the country, in comparison thereto;
(c) whether it is also a fact that out of the
total production of fruits and vegetables
worth one lakh crore rupees, the production
to the tune of rupees 30,000 crore gets
destroyed annually, without utilization; and
(d) the average annual loss of wheat,
paddy and millets in comparison thereto?
Impact of US farm subsidy on Indian
farmers
†2495. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
  SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news item published in
The Business Lines on 28th June, 2002
under caption, "U.S. release $ 100m for
farm exports";
(b) if so, whether it is a fact that 100
million dollars are being given by U.S.A.
as subsidy to promote export of foodgrains;
and
(c) if so, the estimates with regard to its
likely impact on Indian farmers?
Transportation of cattle to Kerala
2496. DR. ARUN KUMAR SARMA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
large scale transportation of cattle from
Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Maharashtra
and Tamil Nadu to Kerala is going on;
(b) if so, the purpose of such
transportation;
(c) whether it violates any existing rules;
and
(d) if so, the steps taken to control the
situation?
Mismanagement in KVKs in UP
2497. SHRI RAJNATH SINGH
'SURYA': Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether complaints of
mismanagement have been received against
some KVKs in U.P.;
(b) if so, which are these KVKs; and
(c) the action taken in those cases?
Training in IT by IASRI
2498. SHRI A. VIJAYA RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to refer to answer to Unstarred
Question 1379 given in the Rajya Sabha on
the 3rd August, 2001 and state:
(a) the profits which were promised to
be generated by the training programme
under the Revolving Fund Project on
Information Technology being conducted
by IASRI and which were actually realized
over the last three years, year-wise;
(b) whether there was any deviation from
project proposal with regard to duration/
